column3: It feels like I'm drifting away softly... Even though I can see things clearly, this doesn't feel real at all...
Why are you so flustered, senpai?
Are you really so concerned about me?
Or... are you here expecting "those" kind of things?
Kuroneko certainly wouldn't do something like this... Wait, could this be... a dream?!
So this is the rumored lucid dream... That's why Kuroneko seems a little off from usual.
She's completely different in reality... Somehow this feels... a little erotic...
